entry: New in Drift: a Perfect Fit streak (end a round with capacity covering everyone who has arrived and no more than 12 to spare; each round in a row adds funds, up to 15, and the streak sits beside the forecast). An optional Crisis Calendar shows fixed events a round ahead (arrivals surges, budget cuts, floods, bumper harvests) and three named Surge Tests at rounds 25, 50 and 75, with a pay-to-brace option and a Held the line card; nothing is random and nothing ends a run. The Mayor's Council offers a pick every 10 rounds from a visible tree of nine programs (Night-School Network, Rapid Housing Modules, Transit Expansion and six follow-ups), each with a trade-off. A Budget Autopilot runs several rounds from your standing rules with a visible log, and finished runs earn 1 to 3 stars on wellbeing, speed to net-positive and efficiency, banked into a run history at round 50. Copy run summary copies a short text with a block-character wellbeing curve. Nothing changes unless you use it or switch the calendar on.

New: a Copy result button under the long-horizon outcomes copies a one-line result (wellbeing, projected wellbeing, people integrated, rounds) to share. Earned achievements now have a Share button, and a Credits link sits at the bottom of the page (in the Help menu on Desktop).

New tools and a collection. Reset this round refunds everything you decided since the round began, and a one-per-region Rewind Token undoes the last Advance Round. Play 5 rounds advances with your current allocation and stops early if strain rises a level, a second wave is announced or the neighbouring district goes critical. A recap line says what each round did, and the Round Ledger keeps a sortable, filterable table of every round with Copy as CSV. The Region Collection keeps ten civic milestones (each with a hint while locked) and five region-personality titles (Builder, Educator, Engineer, Reformer, Balancer), kept in your browser across regions. Keys: 1, 2, 3 buy, Enter advances, U resets the round, P plays 5, L opens the Ledger, C the Collection. Settings gains High Contrast and an Easy-Read Font, and the browser tab title now shows the round and strain. No rules or numbers changed.

Desktop layout for wide windows: the readouts become chips across the top, the region skyline sits over displacement pressure, integration and wellbeing, and your investments, policy toolkit and Advance Round live in a column on the right that scrolls on its own. The Long-Horizon Outcomes, How to Play, Achievements and Settings open as windows, the rest is in the Menu (press Escape), and there is a Desktop walkthrough. Your save works in both layouts, and nothing about the rules changed.

In the real world: a collapsible note pairs your region's situation with one sourced real example. Strain shows Jordan's public services under pressure, a second wave the EU's 2022 temporary protection, and funded policies show Germany's integration courses and qualification recognition or Canada's private sponsorship. Each names its source and links to it, and it never changes any number or your save (W2).

Story mode: a short, grounded story about a region preparing for and welcoming displaced people, with a chapter that unlocks alongside each achievement. A Story panel below the title shows the chapters you have reached; the existing Story on/off pill hides it, and it never changes any number or your save (W1).
Community capacity index: a line showing the average regional wellbeing score across all players' regions (I17).

Neighbouring district: from round 3 you can open a second region with its own starting profile (lots of housing, no integration services, little money, higher pressure), run alongside yours every round. When your region is calm and holds a cushion you can send it support, and a neighbour left in critical strain pushes extra arrivals into yours (I1, I7).
Second wave: once most arrivals have integrated, a larger wave (twice the arrivals for five rounds) tests whether your capacity holds, announced a round ahead and ending with a plain verdict (I25).
Cross-region learning: bringing any region to Thriving once gives every region you start afterwards +10% faster integration (I29).
Policy toolkit: fund Streamlined Credentialing, Language-Access Funding and Community Sponsorship, three named institutional levers with up to three levels each (I3).
Achievement cards now show "Earned by N% of players" once enough real save data exists for that achievement (site-wide goal, Z1/Z27b).
Added a keyboard-shortcuts help overlay: press ? to see it, Esc to close it or whichever panel is open (site-wide goal, Z4).
Settings panel: added a "Reset to Default" button that resets text size and reduce-motion back to their defaults in one click (site-wide goal, folded from A26).
Fixed the investment buttons row overflowing the screen edge on narrow phones.

Capped the per-round history logs (arrivals/strain/wellbeing/sub-score) so long sessions no longer grow an unbounded save -- the lifetime strain average and the critical-strain-recovery achievement still work correctly, unaffected by the cap.
Fixed a display bug where the Achievements/Settings panels showed as empty boxes before their first open and never visually closed again once opened once.

Round-2 polish: capacity forecast, next-milestone estimate, investment ROI, sub-score trend arrows, control line on the trend graph, region naming, Crisis Start mode, capacity reallocation, and a coda legacy choice.
Settings panel: adjustable text size and a Reduce Motion toggle.
Colorblind-safety audit: wellbeing line on the trend graph now dashed, not just a different color.
Achievements added: 18 achievements, in-game panel, unlock toast, hub dashboard link.
Skippable tutorial, a How to Play page, and a mobile sticky HUD.
Space-theme visual pass and a full redesign of the content window.
Save/load added via the shared save widget, so progress carries across devices.
Pass 3: a clear "turning point" callout the moment integration becomes net-positive, plus a sharper feedback question.
Info Page added: real-world sources on climate displacement and institutional preparedness.
Pass 2: Long-Horizon Outcomes coda showing the region's generational payoff.
Pass 1: three-bar wellbeing dashboard, mid-run checkpoint summary, and case-study context blurbs.
All 7 core milestones shipped: allocation loop, displacement pressure, strain vs. capacity, integration payoff, composite wellbeing scoring, feedback prompt, visual/hub pass.
